xwikidoc.content: {{velocity output='false'}} #macro (getField $classField $useDisplay) ## The message is the same for all the fields and events of a request, so compute it only once. #if (!$invalidFieldMessage) #set ($invalidFieldMessage = $escapetool.xml($services.localization.render('xwiki.calendar.jsonservice.invalid'))) #end #set ($result = $invalidFieldMessage) #set ($propertyClass = $itemdoc.getFirstObject($classField).getProperty($classField).getPropertyClass()) #if ($propertyClass) #if (($propertyClass.getClassType() != 'Email' || !$services.mail.general.shouldObfuscate()) && $propertyClass.getClassType() != "Password") #if ($useDisplay) #set ($result = $itemdoc.display($classField)) #else #set ($result = $itemdoc.getValue($classField)) #set ($xdom = $services.rendering.parse($result, 'xwiki/2.1')) #set ($result = $services.rendering.render($xdom, 'plain/1.0')) #end #else #set ($userRef = $xcontext.getUserReference()) #if ($isGuest) #set ($userRef = 'guest user') #end #set ($discard = $services.logging.getLogger('Calendar.JSONService').warn("Forbidden access attempt: User: ${userRef} Class: ${request.classname} Field: ${classField}")) #end #end #end {{/velocity}} {{velocity filter="html" wiki="false"}} #if ($xcontext.action == 'get' && $services.csrf.isTokenValid($request.form_token)) ## The events are returned by pages, to avoid loading a huge number of documents in memory in a single request. When ## more events match, the URL of the next page is returned in the Link response header (RFC 8288), with rel="next". ## The body stays a JSON array of events, so that the service remains compatible with any JSON event feed client. ## At most $maxPages pages are returned for a request: when more events match, the X-Calendar-Truncated response ## header is set on the last page instead of the Link header. ## TODO: When the parent is upgraded to XWiki 17.7.0+, use the platform query limit instead of this hard coded page ## size: #getAndValidateQueryLimitFromRequest (or #validateQueryLimit) validates the limit against the ## security.queryItemsLimit configuration (1000 by default) and sends a 400 error response when it's exceeded or ## when an unlimited query (-1) is requested. #set ($pageSize = 1000) #set ($maxPages = 10) #set ($maxEvents = $mathtool.mul($pageSize, $maxPages)) #set ($offset = $numbertool.toNumber($request.offset).intValue()) #if (!$offset || $offset < 0) #set ($offset = 0) #end #set ($jsonResult = []) #set ($started = false) #set ($extraFields = $request.extraFields.split(',')) #set ($startField = "$!request.startfield") #set ($endField = "$!request.endfield") #set ($durationField = "$!request.durationfield") ## Only the objects having a date value for the start field can be displayed, so filter them in the query instead of ## loading all the documents having an object of the requested class. This means that the start field has to be a ## date property of the requested class, stored as a standard property (so not using a custom mapping). #set ($fromClause = ', BaseObject as obj, DateProperty as startProp') #set ($whereClause = 'doc.fullName=obj.name and obj.className=:classname and startProp.id.id=obj.id and startProp.id.name=:startfield and startProp.value is not null') #set ($bindings = {'classname': "$!request.classname", 'startfield': $startField}) ## Order by object id too, so that the order is stable between the pages for events having the same start date. #set ($orderBy = 'startProp.value, obj.id') ## FullCalendar sends the displayed date range in the start (inclusive) and end (exclusive) parameters, using the ## ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2026-11-16 or 2026-11-16T00:00:00). Only the date part is used (the parsing ignores what ## follows it), interpreted in the user's time zone, which is also the one used to format the event dates below. A ## missing or invalid value is parsed as null, which means no limit. #set ($userTimeZone = $datetool.timeZone.getTimeZone($xwiki.getUserTimeZone())) #set ($rangeStart = $datetool.toDate('yyyy-MM-dd', $request.start, $datetool.locale, $userTimeZone)) #set ($rangeEnd = $datetool.toDate('yyyy-MM-dd', $request.end, $datetool.locale, $userTimeZone)) #if ($rangeEnd) #set ($whereClause = "$whereClause and startProp.value < :rangeEnd") #set ($discard = $bindings.put('rangeEnd', $rangeEnd)) #end #if ($rangeStart) #if ($endField != '') ## Return the events that overlap the displayed range: the events that start inside the range, whenever they end, ## and the events that started before the range and end inside or after it. The start date is also checked, and ## not only the end date, so that an event with an empty end date, or with an end date before its start date, is ## returned when it starts inside the range. ## The end date is joined because a subquery on a property is not allowed without programming rights. As a ## consequence, an event whose object doesn't have the end date property at all (e.g. because the end field was ## added to the class after the event was last saved) is not returned. #set ($fromClause = "$fromClause, DateProperty as endProp") #set ($whereClause = "$whereClause and endProp.id.id=obj.id and endProp.id.name=:endfield and (startProp.value >= :rangeStart or endProp.value >= :rangeStart)") #set ($discard = $bindings.put('endfield', $endField)) #set ($discard = $bindings.put('rangeStart', $rangeStart)) #elseif ($durationField != '') ## The end date is not stored and it can't be computed by the query, so an event that started before the displayed ## range can still be part of it: don't limit the start date, and return the most recent events first, so that ## the limit of returned events applies to the oldest events, which are the least likely to be displayed. #set ($orderBy = 'startProp.value desc, obj.id') #else #set ($whereClause = "$whereClause and startProp.value >= :rangeStart") #set ($discard = $bindings.put('rangeStart', $rangeStart)) #end #end #set ($whereSQL = "$!request.wheresql") #set ($hqlStatement = "$fromClause $!{request.fromsql} where $whereClause $whereSQL") ## Keep the order requested by the caller, if any. #if (!$whereSQL.toLowerCase().matches('(?s).*\border\s+by\b.*')) #set ($hqlStatement = "$hqlStatement order by $orderBy") #end #set ($query = $services.query.hql($hqlStatement)) #foreach ($binding in $bindings.entrySet()) #set ($query = $query.bindValue($binding.key, $binding.value)) #end ## Fetch one more result than the page size to know if there is a next page. The view right is checked after the ## query, so the pagination is based on the query results and not on the number of events returned. #set ($query = $query.addFilter('currentlanguage').setOffset($offset).setLimit($mathtool.add($pageSize, 1))) ## Drop programming rights before the query execution to ensure it is properly validated. #set ($discard = $xcontext.dropPermissions()) #set ($items = []) #if ($startField != '' && $offset < $maxEvents) #set ($items = $query.execute()) #end #set ($nextOffset = $mathtool.add($offset, $pageSize)) #set ($hasMore = $items.size() > $pageSize) #if ($hasMore) #set ($items = $items.subList(0, $pageSize)) #end #foreach ($item in $items) ## Skip the documents the current user is not allowed to view, without loading them. #set ($itemReference = $services.model.resolveDocument($item)) ## Reset the start date, since it's not set below when the access is denied. #set ($startdate = $NULL) #if ($services.security.authorization.hasAccess('view', $itemReference)) #set ($itemdoc = $xwiki.getDocument($itemReference)) #set ($startdate = $itemdoc.getValue($startField)) #end ## #if ($startdate) #set ($start = $xwiki.formatDate($startdate, 'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm')) #set ($allDay = true) #if ($endField != '') #set ($enddate = $itemdoc.getValue($endField)) #set ($end = $xwiki.formatDate($enddate, 'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm')) #set ($allDay = false) #elseif ($durationField != '') #set ($duration = $itemdoc.getValue($durationField)) #set ($enddate = $xwiki.jodatime.getDateTime($startdate.getTime())) #set ($enddate = $enddate.plusMinutes($numbertool.toNumber($duration).intValue())) #set ($end = $xwiki.formatDate($enddate.toDate(), 'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm')) #set ($allDay = false) #end #set ($currentResult = { 'id' : $escapetool.url($itemdoc.fullName), 'title' : $itemdoc.plainTitle, 'url' : $itemdoc.getExternalURL(), 'start' : $start, 'allDay' : $allDay }) ## Ease the use of the extrafields only when all of them (3) are specified ## TODO: Find some better rule to handle this and maybe use a more dynamic list. #if ($extraFields.size() == 3) ## Display the description as plain text. It is expected to be the content of a textarea field, so it has ## to be be processed. The $doc.display() method returns the content wrapped in {{html}} macro, which ## doesn't help in a wiki="false" environment. #getField($extraFields[0].trim() false) #set ($currentResult.description = $result) #getField($extraFields[1].trim() true) #set ($currentResult.location = $result) #getField($extraFields[2].trim() true) #set ($currentResult.status = $result) #end #if ($end) #set ($discard = $currentResult.put('end', $end)) #end #set ($discard = $jsonResult.add($currentResult)) #end #end #if ($hasMore && $nextOffset < $maxEvents) #set ($nextParameters = {}) #foreach ($parameterName in $request.parameterMap.keySet()) #if ($parameterName != 'offset') #set ($discard = $nextParameters.put($parameterName, $request.getParameterValues($parameterName))) #end #end #set ($discard = $nextParameters.put('offset', $nextOffset)) #set ($nextURL = $doc.getURL('get', $escapetool.url($nextParameters))) #set ($discard = $response.setHeader('Link', '<' + $nextURL + '>; rel="next"')) #elseif ($hasMore) #set ($discard = $response.setHeader('X-Calendar-Truncated', "$maxEvents")) #end #if ("$!{request.outputSyntax}" == 'plain') ## Write the JSON directly on the response, to avoid parsing and rendering the output of this macro: this takes ## time and memory when there are many events, and the rendering transformations could alter the JSON. #jsonResponse($jsonResult) #else $jsontool.serialize($jsonResult) #end #end {{/velocity}}
